messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Active ingredient: semaglutide Inactive ingredients:
Ozempic injection: disodium phosphate dihydrate, propylene glycol, phenol, and water for injections. Ozempic has a pH of approximately 7.4. Hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide may be added to adjust pH.
Ozempic tablet: magnesium stearate and salcaprozate sodium
Wegovy injection: disodium phosphate dihydrate, sodium chloride, and water for injection. Phenol and propylene glycol are also inactive ingredients in the single-patient-use Wegovy FlexTouch. Hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide may be added to adjust pH.
Wegovy tablets: salcaprozate sodium (SNAC) and magnesium stearate
Rybelsus R1 formulation: magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, povidone, and salcaprozate sodium (SNAC).
Rybelsus R2 formulation: magnesium stearate and salcaprozate sodium (SNAC).
Triplet: ["semaglutide", "has inactive ingredient", "salcaprozate sodium (SNAC)"]

The relation 'has inactive ingredient' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug contains the inactive component specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has related drug': The subject drug is related to or associated with another drug specified by the object entity.
B. 'has ph': The subject drug has a specific pH level specified by the object entity.
C. 'may have added': The subject drug may include the substance specified by the object entity to adjust or maintain its pH.
D. 'has package content': The subject drug's package includes the specified item or content described by the object entity.
E. 'has administration frequency': The subject drug is administered at the frequency specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
